visualBrief.imagePromptEn: A Victorian-era telegraph station at dusk. A brass ticker-tape machine on a polished wooden desk has printed a strip of tape with checkmark perforations. A large wall-mounted route map with brass pins and small green flags. A leather mail satchel with wax-sealed envelopes. Warm gaslight.
